issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'עִם הַגֹּלָה אֲשֶׁר הָגְלְתָה' refers to 'with the exiles who were exiled' (i.e., the people taken into exile), but the Chinese renders 'הַגֹּלָה' as '擄掠物' (plunder/booty), which changes the meaning from people (exiles) to objects (plunder). This is a substantive mistranslation.
